Maintenance release of the LexVibe MCP server.

## Changes

- **Agent Skill**: `skills/lexvibe-compliance/SKILL.md` tells coding agents when to use this server (before a deploy, after adding an SDK for analytics, payments, auth or AI) and how to report results honestly. The README gains an "Agent skill" section.
- **`claim_app` links last 7 days**, not 30 minutes. The `claim_app` and `get_claim_status` descriptions and the expired-claim message now match the server.

## Verification

- `npm run build` (strict TypeScript) clean.
- `node scripts/smoke.mjs`: stdio boot, initialize + tools/list, 10 tools announced, minimum contract honoured.
- `npm test`: 24/24.
